project.name: Ultrasonic Room
project.author: MTDI Studio example
project.description: An example with a physical sensor: an [[HC-SR04 ultrasonic]] range finder learns the empty room as its environment, then reports anything that enters the beam as a deviation from it.

rules.text: The echo moved well beyond the room's learned ambient variation: an object or person is in the beam, or the sensor moved.

aether.purpose: Shows that MTDI's pillars do not care what a sensor measures: the same Validation Chamber, Environmental Intelligence and NVTRA that serve any other project serve an echo.
